data.high_level_summary: The meeting discussed the implementation of No Brokerhood services for a society. The society is not yet formed, but the registration process is expected to be completed in the next two to three months. The services provided by No Brokerhood include gate management and accounting management. The gate management module can be implemented without society registration, and a demonstration of the module was offered. The meeting also discussed the number of flats in the society and the potential implementation of the gate management module for 84 flats in one of the buildings.
